messages.settings.services.customEndpointHelp: Use an OpenAI Chat Completions compatible endpoint: enter a full Chat Completions URL or a Base URL ending in /v1. The model must support Chat Completions.
messages.settings.services.keys.usageHelp: Rotation distributes requests and switches keys after failures. Using only the first key preserves the other keys.
messages.settings.services.keys.requirementHelp: Choose Key required for authenticated endpoints, or Allow empty for endpoints that accept anonymous requests. A filled key is still used.
messages.settings.services.keys.optionalPlacehold: Optional; a filled key will be used
messages.settings.services.keys.listHelp: You can add several keys. If the endpoint needs no key, set Key requirement to “Allow empty” under API compatibility.

messages.settings.fullPage.multiSegmentDescriptio: Groups adjacent text into one AI request within the batch limits
messages.settings.fullPage.multiSegmentHelp: For AI services that support general prompts; combined services are not supported. Restore the original page and restart full-page translation to apply changes.
messages.settings.fullPage.multiSegmentLimitsHelp: Split when either limit is reached; keep a single long paragraph intact
messages.settings.fullPage.multiSegmentFragmentsA: Maximum text fragments per AI translation batch

messages.settings.floatingBall.title: Floating button settings
messages.settings.floatingBall.toolsDisplayDescri: Show tools on hover and collapse them when the pointer leaves, keep them visible, or show only the brand button.
messages.settings.floatingBall.hoverDelayHelp: Tools open after the pointer rests for this long; 0 ms opens them immediately. A longer delay reduces accidental opening. Keyboard focus always opens them immediately.
messages.settings.floatingBall.clickDescription: “Open quick panel” shows the extension panel beside the button. Hold the button to drag it.
messages.settings.floatingBall.clickDescriptionUs: “Open settings” opens the userscript settings. Hold the button to drag it.
messages.settings.floatingBall.compactDescription: Use a smaller button to cover less webpage content.
messages.settings.floatingBall.settingsEntryDescr: The gear opens the quick panel beside the button, where you can open all settings. Turn this off to hide the gear.
The gear opens the userscript settings. Turn this off to hide the gear.
messages.settings.floatingBall.collapsedOpacityDe: Lower values make the button more transparent. It is fully opaque when hovered, expanded or dragged.
messages.settings.personalCorrections.title: Personal corrections
messages.settings.personalCorrections.description: Edit webpage translations and reuse them within the scope you confirm. Off by default.
messages.settings.personalCorrections.help: When enabled, choose Edit translation beside a bilingual paragraph or press Alt/Option + Shift + E. Turning this off keeps saved corrections and stops showing the entry or reusing corrections.
messages.settings.general.aiContextHelp: You can enable this in advance. Webpage context is collected and sent only with supported AI services; other services keep the preference without sending context.
messages.settings.general.floatingBallDescription: Show a full-page translation entry at the edge of the screen. Adjust its tools and click action in floating button settings.
messages.settings.general.progressPanelDescriptio: During full-page translation, show running and queued task counts at the bottom right of the page. The panel hides when the work finishes.
messages.settings.general.themeDescription: Changes the extension interface only. The webpage colors stay the same.
messages.settings.services.freeWeights.timeoutHel: Each service can wait up to the selected duration, within a shared 20-second total budget. Free translation does not repeat global retries. Retry network errors later; for rate limits, blocks or exhausted quotas, follow the service guidance or choose another service.
